protocol: P2.12 one-time heldout confirmation of frozen P2.11 router-1
paper_scope: conditional safety-critical scenario generation and budgeted candidate selection
scientific_scope: one condition-adaptive prototype selection followed by one episode; not a continuously reactive actor and not AEB-calibrated validation

perturbation_config.interpretation: historically reproducible numerical sensitivity envelope; AEB calibration attribution withdrawn

frozen_method.router: P2.8 branch-specific ridge models with no refit or recalibration
frozen_method.router_input: first five actor-visible history frames with visibility and presence masks; no hidden-target truth-fill

heldout.eligibility: nominal script episode is complete, valid, and safe; router, fixed-prototype, and perturbed-script outcomes never filter conditions
heldout.single_attempt: generate exactly this seed once after explicit user authorization; interrupted execution may resume deterministic cached artifacts but completed results may not be rerun or replaced
heldout.legacy_seed41000: remain sealed and unused because its smaller legacy P2 design does not match the P2.11 minimum eligible sample and final evaluation protocol

comparators.primary_equal_budget: strongest frozen training-rate fixed single prototype, head 1
comparators.secondary: zero-action script under the same perturbation draw
comparators.negative_control: 5000 branch-wise permutations of frozen router top-1 assignments across conditions

decision.both_branches_pass: C3 becomes heldout-confirmed under the frozen numerical sensitivity protocol
decision.either_branch_fails: record final confirmation as a negative result; do not change model, seed, K, eligibility, denominator, or gate
decision.k2_status: P2.10 remains development evidence only and is not substituted after seeing P2.12
